page: Environment API for runtime providers: JavaScript runtime integration with Vite. Environment factories return EnvironmentOptions for common runtime usage (dev and build). Environment: package integration enabling framework/end-user setup. Module: transformed code executed in runtime. Module graph: module relationships in each environment (client, ssr, custom). Module runner: allows running code via Vite plugins. Different from server.ssrLoadModule - runner decoupled from server. Communication: browsers use WebSocket and HTTP, Node module runner direct function calls, other runtimes use custom implementations. DevEnvironment class, HotChannel transport interface. Goals: customizable API to process/run code using exposed primitives. Implementations: runtime providers (Node.js, browser, workerd, worker threads). Usage: DevEnvironment(name, config, {options, hot: boolean, transport: HotChannel}), HotChannel with on/send methods. HotChannel.skipFsCheck: true for non-network transports (worker threads, in-process). ModuleRunner class for target runtime instantiation imported from vite/module-runner. Communication levels: RunnableDevEnvironment, FetchableDevEnvironment, custom. Feedback: GitHub discussions/16358.

sections.manifest: Environment factories intended for runtime providers, not end users. Return EnvironmentOptions for most common runtime usage. Merge userConfig with defaults via mergeConfig(). createWorkerdEnvironment(userConfig) example: resolve.conditions, dev.createEnvironment (createWorkerdDevEnvironment), build.createEnvironment (createWorkerdBuildEnvironment). Config usage: environments: {ssr: createWorkerdEnvironment({build: {outDir: '/dist/ssr'}}), rsc: createWorkerdEnvironment({build: {outDir: '/dist/rsc'}})}. Framework use: const ssrEnvironment = server.environments.ssr. Default outDir and other options set by factory.

Creating new environment factory: Vite exposes two environments by default (client browser, ssr Node), transformed source called module, module graph relationships, transformed code sent to runtimes. Module runner: allows running code via Vite plugins, decoupled from server allowing library/framework communication layer implementation. Browser: WebSocket server communication, HTTP requests. Node: direct function calls same process. Other runtimes: custom JS runtime connections (workerd worker thread). Module evaluation triggers module graph processing for imports. Goal: customizable API using exposed primitives. DevEnvironment, HotChannel implementations for runtime integration. Graphical diagram: Vite Dev Server (Node.js) with DevEnvironment containing Plugin Pipeline, Module Graph, HotChannel; Target Runtime with ModuleRunner containing Module Evaluator, Transport; HMR/Module fetch & invoke bidirectional communication.

ModuleRunner class: constructor(options: ModuleRunnerOptions, evaluator: ModuleEvaluator = new ESModulesEvaluator(), debug?: ModuleRunnerDebugger). Methods: async import<T>(url: string): Promise<T> (accepts file path, server path, or id relative to root), clearCache() (clear caches and HMR listeners), async close() (clear caches, remove HMR listeners, reset sourcemap support, doesn't stop HMR connection), isClosed(): boolean. ESModulesEvaluator exported, uses new AsyncFunction to evaluate. Custom ModuleEvaluator if runtime doesn't support unsafe evaluation. Example usage: new ModuleRunner({transport, createImportMeta: createNodeImportMeta}, new ESModulesEvaluator()), moduleRunner.import('/src/entry-point.js'). Re-execution on full-reload HMR: evaluated modules list updated but exports object overridden, need to re-run import() or get from evaluatedModules.

ModuleRunnerOptions interface: transport (ModuleRunnerTransport, required), sourcemapInterceptor (false|'node'|'prepareStackTrace'|InterceptorOptions, configure source map resolution, 'node' if process.setSourceMapsEnabled available else prepareStackTrace override Error.prepareStackTrace), hmr (boolean|ModuleRunnerHmr, disable/configure HMR, default true), evaluatedModules (EvaluatedModules, custom module cache, separate instance per runner if not provided). Type definitions from vite/module-runner.

ModuleEvaluator interface: startOffset?: number (prefixed lines in transformed code), runInlinedModule(context: ModuleRunnerContext, code: string, id: string): Promise<any> (evaluate Vite-transformed code), runExternalModule(file: string): Promise<any> (evaluate externalized module file URL). ESModulesEvaluator uses new AsyncFunction with inlined source map requiring 2-line offset accommodation (ECMA-262), automatic for ESModulesEvaluator, custom evaluators don't add lines. Implement for non-AsyncFunction-supporting runtimes.

ModuleRunnerTransport interface: connect?(handlers: ModuleRunnerTransportHandlers): Promise<void>|void, disconnect?(): Promise<void>|void, send?(data: HotPayload): Promise<void>|void, invoke?(data: HotPayload): Promise<{result: any}|{error: any}>, timeout?: number. RPC or direct function call communication. If invoke not implemented, send and connect required (Vite constructs invoke internally). Worker thread example with parentPort: connect/send via postMessage, HotChannel on server with WeakMap for listener tracking. HTTP request example: invoke via fetch POST to /invoke endpoint, handleInvoke in NormalizedHotChannel. WebSocket required for HMR: send and connect methods essential. Both examples: createNodeImportMeta helper, ESModulesEvaluator, transport implementation coupling with HotChannel server-side. createServerHotChannel() ready-made HotChannel for SSR in Node.js process: new DevEnvironment(name, config, {hot: true, transport: createServerHotChannel()}).
